goal: Generate a 16:9 horizontal full-width website hero, directly compatible with a top navigation, excluding navigation and footer, only the central banner content area.

left_column.headline: Keep knowledge and projects on the same whiteboard
left_column.subhead: Databases, lists, and boards can reference each other, switching from personal notes to hundred-person collaboration on one screen.

right_column.centerpiece: A large screenshot of a collaborative document interface without specific trademarks: includes a left-side directory tree, central rich text, right-side database properties panel, slightly 3D stacked multiple windows, with soft reflections at the screen edges.
right_column.scale: Occupies 78% of the right side, slightly tilting toward the center of the image

background.type: A gradient from light beige to slightly deeper gray-blue, with the top brighter to highlight the logo position in the upper left corner
background.decoration: 1-2% coverage minor noise and two very fine diagonal auxiliary lines, final draft does not distract

brand.logo_position: Upper left corner reserved 'N' shaped geometry and text small placement, not drawing actual corporate trademarks
brand.navigation_hint: Do not draw the top navigation, leave white space only for the connection between logo and hero in the image

safe_area.rule: Bottom 10% and far right 5% do not place key small text, to avoid full-width cuts and mobile edge cuts
safe_area.mobile_consideration: true, the title area remains fully readable in the upper half when folded into single-column mode

must_keep: The main title is the largest in the left column, with a contrast ratio with the background of ≥4.5:1.
Main button shape clearly defined as a rounded rectangle solid button
Right column interface text uses indicative gray bars or blurred text, does not generate readable real UI mini essays
avoid: The main title overlaps with the 3D product block.
Left column has more than three lines of small text
